headline: Deep learning methods now annotate chromatin architecture from Hi-C contact matrices
label: Deep Learning For Hi C
summary: Compact, foundation-model-based, and interpretable architectures are being applied to single-cell and bulk Hi-C data for structural annotation.
synthesis: The dominant thread is deep learning applied to Hi-C-derived chromatin architecture. scSTEC annotates chromatin subcompartments directly from individual single-cell Hi-C matrices using two-dimensional embedding and chromosome-wise consensus, without imputation. AxialTAD predicts TAD boundaries from Hi-C matrices with an Axial Contrast Module, reporting 76-80% fewer parameters than deepTAD. HiCP2GAN enhances low-resolution contact maps by using a pretrained Vision Transformer Hi-C foundation model as the discriminator of a plug-and-play GAN. The remaining items, PhenoMe for microscopy image embeddings and ViScore/ViVAE for scRNA-seq embedding quality and multi-scale structure preservation, address adjacent representation-learning problems rather than chromatin structure. What is new here is the shift toward single-cell subcompartment annotation and foundation-model-based enhancement within the Hi-C toolkit.
